entities.name: Vintara
entities.description: An almost impregnable forest in Jamuraa, source of elephants and home of vicious turtles.

entities.name: Deadalus
entities.description: A Lich Lord who tried to take power over Chloridon and was killed by Destruction.

entities.name: Destruction
entities.description: A black dragon that killed Deadalus.

events.summary: The Lich Lord Deadalus tried to take power over Chloridon but was killed by the black dragon Destruction.
events.quote: Vintara once saw the Lich Lord Deadalus attempt to take power over the green dragon Chloridon , but ended up being killed by the black dragon Destruction instead.

relations.note: Killed him when he tried to control Chloridon.
relations.quote: but ended up being killed by the black dragon Destruction instead.
